name: Dreamers
overview: Scripture reveals that dreams can serve as a means through which God communicates, especially to prophets, as seen in Numbers 12:6 where the Lord speaks in visions and dreams. Joseph’s role as an interpreter highlights that understanding dreams belongs to God alone (Genesis 40:8). However, the Bible also warns of the potential vanity and confusion in dreams and many words, urging believers to maintain a reverent fear of God rather than placing undue trust in dreams themselves (Ecclesiastes 5:3,7). Dreams, therefore, are a God-ordained but carefully discerned channel of revelation.
